elements.name: Format:
elements.help_text: Container format. Video, audio, and other tracks are combined into a single file of this type. Affects compatibility.

elements.name: Web Optimized
elements.help_text: Optimize MP4 for progressive download. After encoding, data is reorganized and rewritten to allow immediate playback over a network, without needing to download the entire file.

elements.name: Align A/V Start
elements.help_text: Aligns the initial timestamps of all audio and video streams by inserting blank frames or dropping frames. May improve audio/video sync for broken players that do not honor MP4 edit lists.

elements.name: iPod 5G Support
elements.help_text: Add a special MP4 marker to allow playback on vintage iPod 5th Generation devices circa 2006. Other settings may affect compatibility.
Destination path, including directory and file name. This is where your new video will be created, and what it will be named.

elements.name: Browse
elements.help_text: Browse to select a new destination path and file name for your encode.
